description: This file defines the Theme class in the Opencart Catalog Controller Event namespace. The class contains an index method that retrieves theme information based on the route and updates the theme code if a theme override exists.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling theme-related events, specifically loading and overriding theme codes based on theme configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the event to fetch and potentially override the theme code based on theme configuration.
